status: Shared surface geometry and preservation of browser-owned UI are qualified for the recorded cases. Firefox single-select binding is an initial prototype; complete webpage controls and subsequent GTK/Qt integration remain open.
additional_assertion_suite: Existing server-decoration negotiation, density, geometry, titlebar input and lifecycle suite passes.
compiled_components: small pinned Chromium and Firefox preload adapters
coverage: Owned read-only surface observers without application policy metadata.
Multiple observers and coexistence with owned placement; custom extents and xdg geometry offsets.
CSD/SSD, move, fullscreen/restore, unmap/remap, closed observers and invalid roles.
Plain GTK window/move/replacement/display-close, popup fallback and older-compositor unavailability.
Native Firefox single-select full images, trusted DOM selection, cancellation, stale identity, reentrant removal and blur.
Native popup anchors in independent compositor coordinates and real pointer tracking.
Unchanged browser tabs/address field, shared native menus and original tab commands, including Alt+T from the stock Chromium omnibox after host recovery.
Existing Firefox webpage-control regressions: 153 whole native images.
limitations: Firefox dropdown group headings, separators, hidden/hidden-selected options and intrinsic sizing are unfinished.
General browser controls, derivatives, broader DPI/input/IME/accessibility coverage and installed deployment remain unfinished.
GTK and Qt/KDE control/menu/shortcut adapters are subsequent work under the same full goal.
Browser UI replacement is skipped. Any later tab/address-field/toolbar changes require an explicitly requested app-specific patch above the shared layer.
